assumptions.statement: The repository provisional overall design polygon and three key-area polygons are used only for generation, display and relative metrics.
assumptions.impact: All design layers, figures and ratios must be recomputed as a package after cleared official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, statutory green ratio, setbacks and building control lines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: They remain unknown; no design suggestion is an approved control.

assumptions.statement: Existing building, parcel, ownership, vacancy, condition and heritage inventories are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The twelve renewal units illustrate retain/adapt programs and make no demolition commitment.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, utilities, drainage, flood, energy, fire and structural conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility and infrastructure alignments are conceptual and require discipline review.

assumptions.statement: Named stations and operators are proposal roles, not existing institutions or government commitments.
assumptions.impact: Service-level targets become binding only through future operating agreements.

assumptions.statement: Media-forensics performance varies by model, language, device and attack.
assumptions.impact: Results expire, show uncertainty, permit appeal and cannot become irreversible reputation scores.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day pilot, four correction rights, station service contracts and operating roles are design proposals rather than current public services or enacted legal rights.
assumptions.impact: No performance target is presented as achieved. Human handover, same-channel correction, screenless parity, appeal reversal, user understanding and asset/data recovery require authorized field baselines.

assumptions.statement: Building quantities, ownership, condition, staffing agreements and authoritative local cost references are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Projects use S/M/L resource bands and cost-component formulas only; monetary ranges must be added after quantity-based professional costing.

assumptions.statement: Version 1.6 retains the separate 12 m by 8 m participant reference test fit for one P0 only and treats it as the minimum physical carrier of an institutional protocol; the source adjacency diagram remains non-metric and no site placement is selected.
assumptions.impact: The 96 sqm envelope and internal zones may support capacity and procurement screening, but must be rebound to a measured, authorized room before physical release.

assumptions.statement: Fifteen-minute intake, thirty-minute independent review, thirty-minute two-channel correction and thirty-minute retest/recovery handover are participant service-time assumptions.
assumptions.impact: The derived two-case-per-hour bottleneck, eight-person waiting limit and 780 staff-hour schedule are screening values, not field baselines or service promises.

assumptions.statement: Six procurement-package shares allocate a participant reference budget structure without currency, quantities, unit rates, quotes or funding.
assumptions.impact: The shares support scope and recovery-reserve review only; monetary bands require dated, authoritative or professionally cleared rates and owner review.

assumptions.statement: All ten external gates are HOLD and no named organization, signature, field survey, professional sign-off, quote or funding commitment is asserted.
assumptions.impact: The P0 may be reviewed as a pre-implementation package but cannot open for field service; a failed gate selects a bounded safe state or retirement, never an unsupported release.

assumptions.statement: The eight-state machine, seven operating receipt classes, closure record, separation-of-duties rules and A01-A08 results are participant-authored protocol evidence exercised on one controlled synthetic dossier.
assumptions.impact: They demonstrate internal executability and failure closure but do not appoint real organizations, authorize a live case, prove field accessibility or establish operational performance; A09-A12 remain baseline-required and null.
